scope.excluded: multiword entries excluded to avoid overlapping phrase counts
scope.denominator: matched vocabulary tokens and distinct entries in each held-out subset; not all passage tokens
scope.selection: Mean of exact-target token and type coverage at 500/1000/2000 on nonbasic validation subset; no holdout selection
scope.limitations: 2024 vocabulary and CEFR labels are retrospectively defined. Upstream frequency and V2 may include evaluation years and are descriptive comparators, not temporally independent models. Exact matches are not sense-disambiguated. Vocabulary coverage is not measured exam performance.

years.description: Training years, exact hit 1; inferred-only hit 0.5

hybrid25.description: 75% log weighted count + 25% weighted year share

hybrid50.description: 50% log weighted count + 50% weighted year share

hybrid75.description: 25% log weighted count + 75% weighted year share
